title: Book Three · Chapter 164: The First Request
story:
Eight days after his eighteenth birthday, Ronan opens a clean envelope beside his school book.

Anna's roof bookmark is between the pages. He moves it carefully before he starts his twenty-second letter to Leo.

He writes about the birthday game. Dad managed two good returns. Kai made a great deal of noise about them.

Then he tells Leo about the coastal centre and the questions still open on his cost sheet.

I want the application papers now, he writes. I need to see the dates and the work they ask for.

He asks about Leo's own plans, signs the letter, and folds it.

The next envelope is for the centre. Ronan copies its address from the latest reply. He asks for an application form. He asks for the full instructions too.

He reads the request aloud before he puts it inside.

Mum passes the table with a customer's coat.

“A new question?”

“A form this time.”

“Then you need the instructions too.”

He points to the last line.

“I asked.”

She smiles and takes the coat to the window. Ronan writes his return address on both envelopes.

After lunch, he posts the two letters. The stamps come from his separate spending money. His twenty-seven yuan from work and the old twenty and a half remain at home.

He sees Anna at school the next day. She has sent her own request to the design school.

“For the form?”

“And the drawing list.”

He looks at the notebook beside her hand.

“Which drawings?”

“I need their list first.”

She opens the notebook to the fruit shop. The shutter is still half closed in her picture. There are more baskets beneath it now.

Ronan smiles. “The owner will be pleased.”

“He asked for even more fruit.”

She shows him the small note below the picture. Then she puts the drawing away for the lesson.

Later, he sees a familiar word in his school book. It is in the coastal description too. He marks it lightly and asks the teacher about its meaning after class.

The teacher gives him an example with a customer and a date. Ronan writes the example beside the word.

At home, he places the two request copies in his folder. There are no application forms in it yet.

He puts the roof bookmark back in his book. Then he sits near the light. He reads one more part before dinner. Then he tries a sentence with the new word.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

application form＝申请表；instructions＝具体填写与提交说明；request＝索取、询问；return address＝回邮地址。

## 理解问题

1. 本章寄出的两封信各给谁？有没有把索要表格写成已经提交申请？
2. Anna为什么先等绘图清单？Ronan的邮费从哪部分钱出？

## 读句子

**I need their list first.**

拆开看：I / need / their list / first.

我／需要／学校给的清单／先拿到再决定材料。
